Routes: `brew tap jundot/omlx https://github.com/jundot/omlx && brew install omlx` (the repo IS the tap — the URL is required, `brew tap jundot/omlx` alone looks for a nonexistent homebrew-omlx repo), the .dmg app, or from source: `pipx install git+https://github.com/jundot/omlx.git`. Same mlx-community weights; default config.
engine.weights: mlx-community safetensors (same files for every engine)
